bagPolicy.summary: Only small purses, 13 x 4 x 9 inches or smaller, are allowed, and all are searched. Oversized bags and backpacks are not allowed, and Vivarium has no bag storage.
allowed: Small purses 13 x 4 x 9 inches or smaller
bagPolicy.quote: bag storage is NOT available at The Pabst, The Riverside, Miller High Life Theatre, Turner Hall Ballroom or Vivarium.

parking.summary: Vivarium hasn't published parking details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by Vivarium. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: Vivarium's bars open when doors open and serve drinks throughout the show. Pabst Theater Group venues don't serve food, bars are cashless (cards and mobile wallets), and outside food and drinks, including water, are not allowed.
concessions.quote: Our bars at the Pabst, Riverside, Miller High Life Theatre, Turner Hall, and Vivarium

accessibility.summary: All Pabst Theater Group venues have accessible entrances, accessible seating options and elevators or ramps. For help, email tickets@ptglive.com or call the box office at (414) 242-8200.
accessibility.quote: All of our venues have accessible entrances, accessible seating options and elevators or ramps.

reEntry.summary: Vivarium hasn't published re-entry details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

ticketPickup.summary: Vivarium's box office opens two hours before each show's start time. Will call tickets are held at the box office and need a photo ID to pick up. AXS mobile tickets use dynamic barcodes and can't be printed, and everyone 2 and older needs a ticket.
ticketPickup.quote: Turner Hall Ballroom and Vivarium box offices open two hours before the start time for each performance.

gates.summary: Vivarium hasn't published entry and doors details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.
